podcast.body: The Soul Legend wrote the soundtrack to the Black film musical *Sparkle*, a fable about Soul Singers in the 1960s. While the film's actresses recorded the vocals for the movie, Mayfield turned over all the material to Aretha Franklin for the official soundtrack album. "In 1976, Soul Legend Curtis Mayfield wrote the soundtrack to the Black Film Musical Sparkle, a fable about a family of Soul Singers in the 60s..."

podcast.body: Curtis Mayfield produced the soundtrack for the 1976 movie "Sparkle," which was considered the best aspect of the film. While Irene Cara sang the songs in the movie, Aretha Franklin performed them on the official soundtrack album. "For my money, the best thing about Sparkle was Curtis Mayfield's soundtrack."
